Missing endpoints, incomplete Type providers, inline filters and syntax recovery do not certify empty closure. General metadata/filter predicates, all contextual resolution, implicit construction and complete metamodel traversal remain open. Complete results certify this bounded query, not whole-model validity.

assessments.obligation: Expose evaluated expression-valued bounds with explicit completeness.
assessments.limits: Static package providers support checked arithmetic and conditionals with Boolean literals, references and nested tests. MULT-016 now passes; selected branches preserve exact bounds and unselected unbound/undefined values are not executed. Unavailable or non-Boolean conditions, invalid selected values, recursive/ineligible branches and shadowed designated operators remain unknown. General predicates, other control operators, direct function execution and all contextual/evaluation semantics remain unqualified. An unresolved base elsewhere in the workspace can conservatively invalidate unrelated arithmetic/conditional certificates (KERNEL-004); native/WASM tests retain this pre-existing proof-isolation limit.
